metadata.article_title: To whom commission may be issued.

article.title: To whom commission may be issued.
article.content:
21To whom commission may be issued.

Order 26, Rule 21
A commission under rule 19 may be issued to any Court within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the witness resides, or, where 3*** the witness resides within the
local limits of 1[the ordinary original civil jurisdiction of the High Court], to any person whom the Court thinks fit to execute the commission.

Page 187
3 The words “the high Court is established under the Indian High Courts Act 1861, or the Government of India Act, 1915, and” omitted by the A.O. 1937.
Page 188
1 Subs. by the A.O. 1937 for “its ordinary original civil jurisdiction”.
